summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan ate at the restaurant until they met an old friend, Jun Omura. Victim: Yoshiro Ikuta Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Masami Kusaka, Yoichi Shimizu, Kouji Takeno, and Hidenori Nakamura How can blood from one victim, murdered on the street, wind up on the wall of an abandoned building, the railing of a rooftop, and broken glass of an upper apartment window? This is the question Conan must answer if he is to catch a crafty killer entrenched in a seemingly innocent mountain-climbing fraternity, which hides a deadly secret. Location: Snow Mountain Victim: Keiko Togawa Cause of death: Frozen to death Suspects: Yoshiro Ikuta, Masami Kusaka, Yoichi Shimizu, Kouji Takeno, and Hidenori Nakamura Ikuta left Keiko, whose foot was injured, and walked down the mountain. Ikuta survived. When they finally reached Keiko, she had already frozen to death. Takeno was Keiko's boyfriend.
